39/S0.subgoal: Explain the three categories of interaction techniques used in immersive environments.

39/S1.subgoal: Explain the distinction between selection and manipulation and the parameters that determine suitable selection techniques.

39/S2.subgoal: Explain various hand selection techniques, including travel techniques like go-go and prism.

39/S3.subgoal: Describe pointing-based selection techniques and improvements like bend cast and depth ray.

39/S4.subgoal: Explain image plane and volumetric selection techniques for 2D and 3D regions.

39/S5.subgoal: Describe the goal of object manipulation and the hand manipulation technique.

39/S6.subgoal: Describe indirect manipulation techniques using 3D widgets, proxies, and World in Miniature.

39/S7.subgoal: Explain bimanual manipulation techniques, including spindle and spindle plus wheel.

39/S8.subgoal: Describe the integrated hybrid manipulation technique known as HOMER.

39/S9.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
